correctness.rationale: Exact event identity partitions the 2^(r-1) unprotected-survivor configurations by cardinality. All bipartite graphs are covered up to plant permutation by nondecreasing nonzero row masks; breadth-first connectivity filtering yields 64,820 connected representatives across m+r<=9 and the verifier finds a simultaneous coefficientwise winner in every one. These inequalities imply optimality over the full open real interval because each Bernstein basis weight is strictly positive. In the ten-vertex witness the exact coefficient table gives R_B-R_A=p(1-p)^2(1-2p); A dominates the other three candidates. The included executable and JSON certificate verify finite counts and direct rational probabilities; no simulation-to-infinity extrapolation.

originality.rationale: The claim is the sharp connected bipartite ecological all-plants success cutoff, not the established coherent-reliability polynomial or general importance ranking. Relevant earlier full-text studies address nestedness or extinction simulations with rewiring, and an earlier expected-richness result does not imply the all-plants joint objective. Search results contain no stronger or exact matching published implication. Abstract-only older cut-based importance literature creates a genuine residual risk; independent bibliographic review is not performed.
residual_risks: A prior exact cutoff might be indexed under monotone CNF, coherent-system component importance, insurance, or stochastic set cover rather than plant–pollinator terminology.
Butler 1977 full technical body was inaccessible; its abstract is insufficient to make a whole-document noncoverage claim.
Search results and accessible indexed public records cannot prove absolute uniqueness or independent priority.

value.rationale: The exact smallest-total-species threshold answers when the best biodiversity insurance target can be chosen without estimating baseline survival. The stronger low-order coefficientwise dominance statement supplies a common order at every survivor cardinality, while the connected ten-vertex witness switches the unique optimal intervention at precisely p=1/2. Unlike a routine mean-richness calculation, simultaneous plant persistence captures joint coextinction risk driven by neighborhood overlap. The threshold is a motivated structural barrier and makes no unsupported prediction of empirical long-term coexistence.
